rooms.name: Gates of Ravenloft
rooms.desc: The road runs out onto a tongue of rock with fog on three sides. Two broken stone turrets flank its end; beyond them an old drawbridge on rusty chains spans a fifty-foot chasm of boiling fog to a gate in the castle's towering west wall. Hollow-eyed gargoyles lean out from the battlements, and through the tunnel the keep's doors stand open on warm light.
rooms.dm: The carriage from I halts on the cobbles before the turrets and its door swings open by itself; its horses cannot be turned. The bridge is lowered when the party arrives; after the illusion at K10 it rises and the portcullis drops (see J-bridge).

rooms.name: The Cut
rooms.desc: The road squeezes through a notch between the crag and a rock knob; a seep from the crag face has frozen across it into a sheet of black ice hung with icicles.
rooms.dm: Thirty feet of ice: anyone moving faster than a walk, or a horse, makes a DC 10 Dexterity save or falls prone. Loose scree lies on the inner verge.

rooms.name: The Hairpin
rooms.desc: The road swings hard round the rock knob and turns due east, and Castle Ravenloft suddenly fills the sky. Old cobbles show through the dirt and the wheel ruts bite deep on the outside of the bend.
rooms.dm: Vistani escorts will not go past this bend, and say so. On foot from the fork at I: about an hour; by the black carriage about 45 minutes.

rooms.name: The Widow's Notch
rooms.desc: A worn bite in the chasm rim, the turf scuffed to bare rock and the lip scored with marks like fingernails.
rooms.dm: Where the ghost from the wilderness tables walks its possessed host and throws the body into the chasm (p.30). DC 10 Wisdom (Survival): several people were walked here and went over without a struggle.

rooms.name: The Drawbridge
rooms.desc: Old beams and planks shored up and patched, three squares wide and fifty-six feet across the fog, boards missing here and there. It groans under every step and the chains creak overhead.
rooms.dm: Each creature crossing (not Strahd, not his carriage horses): roll d20, on a 1 a board gives way, DC 10 Dexterity save or fall 1,000 ft; advantage if a companion within 5 ft grabs. A Large carriage fills the deck. Fog lightly obscures the deck beyond 30 ft. Raised (after K10): the deck stands against the gate and the chains hang taut.

rooms.name: Gate tunnel
rooms.desc: A tunnel twenty feet wide and eighteen high through the wall, a rotting green portcullis hanging over its mouth, warm light at its far end.
rooms.dm: Green slime clings under the portcullis (DC 20 Wisdom (Perception)); it falls on the first creature to leave the castle this way.

rooms.name: North gate tower
rooms.desc: A squared tower against the wall's inner face, its ironbound door shut and locked.
rooms.dm: Hollow, flagstone floor: one of the two latches for the bridge and portcullis. Both must be released, by Strahd's command word or dispel magic (DC 14) on each, before either moves.

rooms.name: South gate tower
rooms.desc: The second gate tower, twin of the first, its ironbound door shut and locked.
rooms.dm: The other latch. Both latches together, or neither moves.

rooms.name: Front courtyard (K1)
rooms.desc: A strip of the castle's front courtyard inside the gate; across it the keep's doors stand open and lit.
rooms.dm: This is K1 of Castle Ravenloft (ch04, p.52): the weather turns as the party enters, drizzle becoming a downpour within the hour, lightning on the ridge behind them.

rooms.name: The Brink
rooms.desc: The spur's south edge steps down over two broken rock terraces and ends at a sheer drop; through breaks in the fog the valley and the roofs of Barovia show far below.
rooms.dm: Each terrace drops 10 to 15 ft (1d6 bludgeoning per 10 ft fallen). Past the cliff edge the fall is 1,000 ft.

objects.label: The chasm and the North Gully
objects.desc: A fifty-foot cleft between the spur and the castle's rock, sheer and slick, and a side-cleft of it biting back behind the north turret; both drop into fog a few yards down.

objects.label: Black ice
objects.desc: A sheet of black ice glazes the road where a seep from the crag crosses it, scored by hooves and wheels; icicles hang from the rock above.

objects.label: Carriage apron
objects.desc: The old thoroughfare's cobbles come up through the dirt here, rutted by one pair of wheels.

objects.label: Turning loop
objects.desc: Wheel ruts swing off the cobbles through the turf in a loop and back.

objects.label: Gutter spout
objects.desc: The cobbles' carved gutter ends in a weathered beast-mouth spout that drips into the fog.

objects.label: North turret
objects.desc: A roofless round guard tower split by weather; a doorway on the road side, its inner stair fallen in, one arrow slit looking at the bridge.

objects.label: South turret
objects.desc: A broken tooth of a tower, open to the sky, its jagged top white with ravens' droppings.

objects.label: Fallen gargoyle
objects.desc: A stone gargoyle lies face up where it fell from the wall long ago, half sunk in turf, one wing snapped off beside it.

objects.label: Worn notch in the rim
objects.desc: A bite worn out of the chasm's lip, the turf scuffed down to bare rock.

objects.label: Mainland sill
objects.desc: A squared stone abutment on the lip with an iron-shod rest worn into a trough by centuries of lowering.

objects.label: The drawbridge
objects.desc: Fifty-six feet of old shored-up beams and planks, three squares wide, boards missing; it groans under every step.

objects.label: Drawbridge chain
objects.desc: A rust-eaten chain runs from the bridge's end up to a slot sixty feet up the wall, creaking in the wind.

objects.label: Chain slot
objects.desc: A dark slot high in the wall face where the chain runs in, rust streaking the stone below it.

objects.label: Drawbridge chain
objects.desc: A rust-eaten chain runs from the bridge's end up to a slot sixty feet up the wall, creaking in the wind.

objects.label: Chain slot
objects.desc: A dark slot high in the wall face where the chain runs in, rust streaking the stone below it.

objects.label: Curtain wall
objects.desc: Castle Ravenloft's west wall rises ninety feet sheer from the far lip of the chasm.

objects.label: Curtain wall
objects.desc: Castle Ravenloft's west wall rises ninety feet sheer from the far lip of the chasm.

objects.label: Rotting portcullis
objects.desc: A wooden portcullis, rotten and furred green, hangs drawn up in the tunnel mouth.
objects.dm: Raised. The patch of green slime on its underside does not fall on anyone entering; it drops on the first creature to leave the castle this way (DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) to spot).

objects.label: Gate tower
objects.desc: A squared tower straddling the wall's inner face, an ironbound door on its courtyard side.

objects.label: Gate tower
objects.desc: A squared tower straddling the wall's inner face, an ironbound door on its courtyard side.

objects.label: The keep's open doors
objects.desc: Across the courtyard the keep's great doors stand open, torches guttering either side and warm light spilling down the steps; high above, a round window of broken glass shows no light.

objects.label: Castle Ravenloft
objects.desc: Beyond the courtyard the keep's dark bulk and towers rise over the lit doors, the castle's inner ranges black on either side.

objects.label: Green slime under the portcullis
objects.dm: Green slime (DMG). DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) to spot. It ignores those coming in and drops on the first creature to leave by this tunnel.

objects.label: Latch mechanism (bridge and portcullis)
objects.dm: Both latches must be released (Strahd's command word, or dispel magic DC 14 on each) before the bridge or portcullis moves. The tower door is ironbound and locked.

objects.label: Latch mechanism (bridge and portcullis)
objects.dm: Both latches must be released (Strahd's command word, or dispel magic DC 14 on each) before the bridge or portcullis moves. The tower door is ironbound and locked.

objects.label: Greased iron in the chain slot
objects.dm: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) from the sill: the iron inside the slot is bright and greased while all round it rusts. Someone keeps the mechanism, and not by hand.

objects.label: Greased iron in the chain slot
objects.dm: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) from the sill: the iron inside the slot is bright and greased while all round it rusts. Someone keeps the mechanism, and not by hand.

objects.label: Rotten board
objects.dm: House rule: DC 12 Perception or Investigation along the deck picks out the four worst boards. Stepping over them still rolls the d20, but the DM may grant advantage on the Dexterity save.

objects.label: Finger-scores and a dropped boot
objects.dm: DC 10 Wisdom (Survival): several people were walked to this spot and went over without a struggle.

objects.label: Fresh ruts, one vehicle only
objects.dm: DC 10 Survival: fresh ruts, no dung, no hoofprints off the cobbles, no foot traffic; the same carriage turns here and goes back. Only one vehicle ever uses this road.

objects.label: Signal-brazier bracket
objects.dm: DC 12 Intelligence (Investigation): a bracket for a signal fire, charcoal in the rubble, the old way of calling for the bridge before the latches answered to one voice.

objects.label: Drilled eye sockets
objects.dm: DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation): the eye sockets are drilled clean through and the wing is solid stone. This one was only ever a carving.

objects.label: Strahd's black carriage
objects.desc: The black carriage stands on the cobbles before the turrets, its side door hanging open, its lamps lit.
objects.dm: Arrives from I and halts here; the door opens by itself. If nobody gets in or out it turns on the loop and returns to the fork empty. The horses cross the bridge without any board risk.

objects.label: Black draft horse (Strahd's)
objects.dm: Under Strahd's control: no teamster can turn, stop or frighten it.

objects.label: Black draft horse (Strahd's)
objects.dm: Under Strahd's control: no teamster can turn, stop or frighten it.

objects.label: Ghost leading its host to the notch
objects.dm: Only if the wilderness ghost (p.30) possessed a character: it walks the body to the Widow's Notch and throws it into the chasm. The party has the walk to stop it.

objects.label: Swarm of bats (optional)
objects.dm: Optional, not in the book here: at dusk or when a board breaks a column of bats boils up out of the fog past whoever is mid-bridge. A distraction, not a fight.

objects.label: Swarm of ravens (Keepers of the Feather)
objects.dm: Keepers of the Feather watching the gate; they scatter when the carriage arrives and never attack. They may carry word of the party.

objects.label: Weather: the moment the party passes the gate the first cold drizzle starts; within the hour a torrent, lightning on the crag behind them and thunder that shakes the deck.
North-west: the road back round the mountain to the fork at I, about 2 miles. There is no road up from the village: the valley floor is 1,000 ft straight down off the Brink.
The North Gully's rim is undercut and unfenced: a shove or a fumble here is the same 1,000-ft fall as the chasm.
Crossing on foot: d20 per creature per crossing, a board breaks on a 1; DC 10 Dexterity save or fall 1,000 ft (20d6 at the cap). Mercy: the faller snags on the ledge 35 ft down (ledge level).

Raised bridge (after K10): set "up" to 1 on the drawbridge, on both chains and on the four rotten boards (nothing needs moving); the deck then stands against the gate, the chains run short and taut to their slots, and the road ends between the turrets.

levels.name: Curtain wall top and gate-tower heads

rooms.name: Wall-walk and tower heads
rooms.desc: A crenellated walk along the top of the ninety-foot wall, the gate-tower heads either side of the gate; from here the whole spur lies open, and the chasm's fog far below.
rooms.dm: Reached by the stairs inside the gate towers. A cloaked figure here is Strahd's choice of welcome; no stat block is needed. The gargoyles are stone; the living ones are inside.

objects.label: Stone gargoyle
objects.desc: A hollow-eyed stone gargoyle leans out from the battlements over the chasm, grinning down at the bridge.

objects.label: Cloaked figure on the wall (Strahd, if he chooses)
objects.dm: Strahd watching the carriage arrive, if he likes; he is gone before anyone reaches the wall.

objects.label: Vantage: the whole spur, the hairpin and the chasm both ways. Wall 90 ft high; the merlons give half cover.

rooms.name: Chasm ledge
rooms.desc: A shelf of wet rock thirty-five feet down the chasm wall under the bridge's outer end, fog swirling just below it. Broken boards have jammed into a drift here around old bones in rusted mail.
rooms.dm: Reachable only by rope from the sill; the chasm walls are slick and sheer (climber's kit and DC 15 Athletics, or magic). A character who falls from the bridge may snag here if the DM is merciful. Below, the fog fills everything and the map stops.

objects.label: Skeleton in rusted mail, a purse of 23 sp, a snapped lantern
objects.dm: A former adventurer; his companions may be vampire spawn in the castle now. Purse: 23 sp.
